title: test(utils): use runAllMicroTasks
body: This PR introduce a first test utils: `runAllMicroTasks`. We use it only once at the moment but we'll introduce some features that will require its usage in the next PRs. Basically it flushes the micro-tasks queue without relying on Jest's fake timers.
